title.rendered: City Club San Francisco Wedding DJ

content.rendered:
City Club San Francisco Wedding DJ – Stock Exchange –
Jie Lei / Matt Sussman August 9th 2014 Wedding Song List.

Jewish Chinese American Wedding DJs

Logistics
Cocktail hour begins at 5pm
We will have a receiving line for the first 30 minutes of the cocktail hour with Jie, myself and our parents
Guests will be seated for dinner at 6pm
When guests are seated for dinner, Jie’s father, Ted Lei, will be giving a champagne toast
We will have speeches beginning at 7pm – the speeches will be delivered, in order by Dan Berstein (best man), Kari Lei (maid of honor) and Stacy Sussman (mother of the groom)
After speeches, Jie and I will thank everyone for coming and invite everyone on to the dance floor
We will then have our first dance to John Legend’s All of Me
From there we will open up the dancing
Cake cutting will be at 9pm followed by dancing until the event ends at 10pm
